headline: International Paper (IP) Stock Fair Value Rises After Split Analyst Calls On Containerboard Pricing
summary: International Paper now carries a higher fair value estimate, moving from US$39.36 to US$43.64, which signals an updated view on where the stock may be reasonably priced. This change sits alongside a mixed set of analyst opinions, with some pointing to higher price targets tied to containerboard pricing and others stepping back to more neutral stances as they weigh demand and cost pressures.
